claim_boundary: This audit establishes exact pre-commit interception for executed valid calls in the completed AgentDojo run. It does not establish global contract or envelope soundness, nor mediation of remote services outside the sandbox.

O1_contract_soundness.evidence: All 67 registered schema fields are retained as security fields and one-field sandbox tests are recorded.
O1_contract_soundness.gap: Finite base-state field tests do not prove that every reachable compound effect is covered.

O2_envelope_soundness.evidence: Permission plans are produced before tool output and injected INFORMATION blocks are removed from resolver evidence.
O2_envelope_soundness.gap: The LLM-generated envelope has no independent semantic soundness proof for every task.

O3_complete_mediation.evidence: Every valid call with a tool-result event has an exactly matching pre-commit signature.
O3_complete_mediation.scope: Official AgentDojo v1.1.2 sandbox logs only.

O4_check_use_integrity.evidence: The tool-result call signatures exactly match the checked signatures; the patched executor uses the checked call object.
O4_check_use_integrity.gap: No claim is made for concurrent remote services or post-check mutation outside this executor.

O5_fail_closed_uncertainty.evidence: Missing descriptors/plans and unresolved fields replan; all optional security defaults in these suites are None or empty.
O5_fail_closed_uncertainty.gap: Other tool ecosystems may have effect-bearing nonempty defaults and require explicit default instantiation.
